component.name: CastMirror
component.summary: Send this PC's screen to a Chromecast or Cast TV

description.p: CastMirror mirrors a display or a single application window to any Google Cast, Android TV or Nest receiver on the local network. It speaks the Cast Streaming protocol natively and does not need a Chrome installation.

ul.li: Display or single-window capture on X11 (XRandR, XComposite, MIT-SHM) and on Wayland via the xdg-desktop-portal ScreenCast API over PipeWire
VAAPI hardware H.264 encoding with an FFmpeg libx264 software fallback
Opus audio captured from the PulseAudio / PipeWire default sink monitor, with host mute restoration on stop
Automatic bitrate and resolution adaptation with a live latency, bitrate, RTT and packet-loss HUD
Six quality presets plus an inline bitrate ceiling and capture frame-rate control
Freeze and mute controls, system tray integration and desktop notifications
LAN receiver discovery over mDNS/DNS-SD with manual IP entry

screenshot.caption: Cast tab: pick a receiver and choose what to share
Live session: adaptive ladder, latency HUD, freeze and mute
Settings: bitrate ceiling, capture frame rate, playout delay
Logs: searchable console with severity filters
Ready state: a receiver discovered on the LAN

description.p: First release: native Cast Streaming sender with X11 and Wayland capture, VAAPI/libx264 encoding, Opus audio, adaptive bitrate ladder, GTK 4 + libadwaita desktop app and an interactive CLI.
